subject: english
stem: After a school added recycling bins, mixed trash fell by 20%. Other programs also began that month. Which claim is careful?
options: Bins alone certainly caused the entire drop.
Recycling has no relation to waste.
Mixed trash fell after the changes, but one program cannot be isolated as the cause.

optionRationales.reason: Bins alone certainly caused the entire drop.：混淆其他 programs。
Mixed trash rose by 20%.：方向相反。
Recycling has no relation to waste.：資料至少顯示同時變化。
Mixed trash fell after the changes, but one program cannot be isolated as the cause.：多方案同時發生，不能單獨歸因 bins。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「結論的每個範圍詞與因果強度都不超過文中方法和結果」可推出 Mixed trash fell after the changes, but one program cannot be isolated as the cause.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Mixed trash fell after the changes, but one program cannot be isolated as the cause. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
